name: GAN 12 UI 3x3 Bluetooth Smart Cube - PowerPod Charger (Magnetic, MagLev, UV Coated)

Featuring MagLev, a grippy UV coated exterior, and incredibly smooth turning, the GAN 12 UI delivers top-tier performance both physically and digitally.
features: Holds a total of 8 charges for your smart cube
Power level indicated by lights on the case
